rationale: "Bye Bye Bye" is the lead single of No Strings Attached (2000); the MSG concert is a real video release but 2000-era, not a 2014 album, and the canonical release is No Strings Attached. | sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bye_Bye_Bye, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/No_Strings_Attached_(NSYNC_album)
